_howto: The homepage feed mixes upcoming events, the Daily Word, videos, the podcast and these posts. Add your own posts (Facebook, Instagram, announcements) to "posts" — newest date shows first. platform can be: facebook, instagram, youtube, substack, site. url and image are optional. The "auto" list is filled every day by generate-social-feed.js (YouTube uploads + Substack posts) — don't edit it by hand.

posts.title: Family Night 2026 photos are up
posts.text: Rock Solid Man × Living Truth Collective — a night of worship, prayer and fellowship at Woodlands.

Thank you to everyone who came out to Family Night! Our next Family Night is Monday, Dec 7 at 7 PM: a Christmas celebration with Living Truth Collective at Woodlands Coffee & Roasters. Open to ALL — bring the whole family and anyone you know.
New on the site: videos & shorts. Watch "There's a Seat for You" and three new shorts.
